project_info.theme: Toyota coolant as a premium engine spa treatment
project_info.color_palette: Tropical blue, warm beige, black, chrome silver, sunset gold

main_subject.detail: A playful premium product poster with a tropical spa setting labeled 'TOYOTA ENGINE SPA'. On a cushioned spa bed sits a detailed Toyota engine wearing black sunglasses and topped with a folded white towel. Beside it stands a large black coolant bottle labeled 'Nuoc Lam Mat Sieu Ben', with Toyota Motor Vietnam branding and a 3.785 l capacity marking. Main headline reads 'GIU Mat DONG CO HIEU SUAT BEN LAU'. A small benefit plaque lists 'BAO VE TOI UU', 'VAN HANH EM AI', and 'KEO DAI TUOI THO'. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Whimsical premium-maintenance poster combining photoreal engine hardware with spa-resort styling and product-packshot clarity

composition_elements.text: TOYOTA ENGINE SPA / GIU Mat DONG CO / HIEU SUAT BEN LAU / Nuoc Lam Mat Sieu Ben / BAO VE TOI UU / VAN HANH EM AI / KEO DAI TUOI THO / Move your world
items: Top Left: Lit 'TOYOTA ENGINE SPA' sign on a wood-textured spa wall
Top Right: Tropical seascape and sunset sky behind the product bottle
Bottom Left: Benefit plaque with three maintenance claims beside a spa drink and folded towels
Bottom Right: Large black coolant bottle and handwritten 'Move your world'
Center/Background: Toyota engine posed like a spa guest on a cushioned massage bed with sunglasses and towel

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sunset reflections, polished metallic engine shine, tropical relaxation mood with humorous product staging

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal product-concept composite with premium advertising retouching

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota coolant maintenance product styled like a premium engine spa. Centerpiece is a detailed Toyota engine resting on a spa bed, wearing sunglasses and a folded towel, with a large black coolant bottle labeled 'Nuoc Lam Mat Sieu Ben' beside it. Background is a tropical spa-resort environment with ocean view and warm sunset light. Surrounding elements: lit sign 'TOYOTA ENGINE SPA', exact headline 'GIU Mat DONG CO HIEU SUAT BEN LAU', benefit plaque 'BAO VE TOI UU', 'VAN HANH EM AI', 'KEO DAI TUOI THO', and footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal product-concept composite with premium advertising retouching, warm resort-commercial lighting, polished metallic shine and tropical relaxation mood, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
